knowledge:
- key_parameters: ploidy=Set in loadGDS() to handle polyploid populations (e.g., ploidy = 4 for tetraploid, ploidy = 6 for hexaploid) ;; node=In estGeno(), explicitly specifies whether raw ("raw") or filtered ("filt") read counts should be used ;; ref_qtile/alt_qtile=In setCallFilter(), recommended setting of c(0, 0.9) to filter out markers with overrepresented reads ;; dp_qtile=In setCallFilter(), used instead of ref_qtile/alt_qtile if the population contains samples with only reference or alternative reads at the majority of markers ;; mono/bi=In setParents(), automatically filters out SNPs that are not monomorphic in each parental sample and not biallelic between parents ;; het_parents=In estGeno(), set to TRUE if the population is derived from outbred parents ;; iter=In estGeno(), specifies the number of iterations for parameter optimization (default/recommended is 4) ;; format=In gbsrGDS2CSV(), set to "qtl" to format output for the R/qtl package, converting physical positions to genetic distances (cM) using bp2cm
- alternatives: SNP callers like GATK and TASSEL-GBS are used to generate the input VCF. Downstream packages like SNPRelate, GWASTools, and GENESIS are compatible with the GDS files generated by gbscleanr for regression, relatedness, and PCA analyses
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have raw GBS or RAD-seq genotype data in VCF format from a mapping population (diploid or polyploid) derived from two or more parents, and you need to perform quality control, filter out unreliable calls, and estimate true genotypes along chromosomes using an HMM
- pitfalls: Stream Read Error (need 12 byte(s) but receive 0) indicates GDS file corruption, which occurs if a process accessing the GDS file is killed; the GDS file must be remade using gbsrVCF2GDS(). Non-biallelic markers are automatically removed during VCF to GDS conversion. If setCallFilter() has not been executed, the user-specified node argument in estGeno() is ignored and the "raw" node is used by default. Setting replicates for parents after setting parents via setParents() will assign the same member ID to the replicates of each parent; replicates should ideally be set first. Filtering with ref_qtile/alt_qtile on populations where samples have only ref or alt reads at most markers will set a large portion of markers to missing; use dp_qtile instead

workflows.name: gbs_genotype_error_correction
workflows.intent: Convert raw VCF genotype data to GDS, perform quality control and filtering, define the breeding scheme, estimate true genotypes using HMM, and export the corrected genotypes.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert VCF to GDS ;; 2. Load GDS ;; 3. Summarize and visualize raw data ;; 4. Apply filters ;; 5. Set replicates (optional) ;; 6. Set parents ;; 7. Prepare breeding scheme ;; 8. Run genotype estimation ;; 9. Retrieve and export results ;; 10. Visualize read ratios and dosages ;; 11. Close GDS connection
workflows.code:
library("GBScleanR")
vcf_fn <- system.file("extdata", "sample.vcf", package = "GBScleanR")
gds_fn <- tempfile("sample", fileext = ".gds")
gbsrVCF2GDS(vcf_fn = vcf_fn, out_fn = gds_fn, force = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
gds <- loadGDS(gds_fn, verbose = FALSE)
nsam(gds)
nmar(gds) 
head(getChromosome(gds)) 
head(getPosition(gds)) 
head(getAllele(gds)) 
head(getMarID(gds)) 
head(getSamID(gds)) 
geno <- getGenotype(gds)
geno <- getRead(gds)
gds <- countGenotype(gds)
gds <- countRead(gds)
histGBSR(gds, stats = "missing") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "het") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "raf") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "dp") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "ad_ref") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "ad_alt") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "rrf") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "mean_ref") 
histGBSR(gds, stats = "sd_ref") 
plotGBSR(gds, stats = "missing")
plotGBSR(gds, stats = "geno")
pairsGBSR(gds, stats1 = "missing", stats2 = "dp")
gds <- setCallFilter(gds, dp_count = c(5, Inf))
gds <- setCallFilter(gds, dp_qtile = c(0, 0.9))
gds <- setCallFilter(gds, ref_qtile = c(0, 0.9), alt_qtile = c(0, 0.9))
gds <- setMarFilter(gds, missing = 0.2)
gds <- thinMarker(gds, range = 150) 
gds <- countGenotype(gds, node = "filt")
gds <- countRead(gds, node = "filt")
sample_id <- getSamID(gds, valid = FALSE)
gds <- setReplicates(gds, replicates = rep(1:51, each = 2))
p1 <- grep("Founder1", getSamID(gds, valid = FALSE), value = TRUE)
p2 <- grep("Founder2", getSamID(gds, valid = FALSE), value = TRUE)
gds <- setParents(gds, parents = c(p1, p2), mono = TRUE, bi = TRUE)
gds <- makeScheme(gds, generation = 2, crosstype = "self")
gds <- estGeno(gds, node = "filt", iter = 4)
est_geno <- getGenotype(gds, node = "cor")
parent_geno <- getGenotype(gds, node = "parents")
est_hap <- getHaplotype(gds)
out_fn <- tempfile("sample_est", fileext = ".vcf.gz")
gbsrGDS2VCF(gds, out_fn)
gbsrGDS2VCF(gds, out_fn, node = "cor")
out_fn <- tempfile("sample_est", fileext = ".csv")
gbsrGDS2CSV(gds, out_fn)
gbsrGDS2CSV(gds, out_fn, node = "cor")
gds <- reopenGDS(gds)
plotReadRatio(x = gds, coord = c(3, 4), ind = 3, node = "raw", size = 2)
plotReadRatio(x = gds, coord = c(3, 4), ind = 3, node = "filt", size = 2)
plotDosage(x = gds, coord = c(3, 4), ind = 3, node = "raw", size = 2)
plotDosage(x = gds, coord = c(3, 4), ind = 3, node = "filt", size = 2)
closeGDS(gds)
